auth.why: 401 NOT PROVEN: the v0.71.4 release pin does not carry the D-04 auth fix (paiml/aprender#5451, open and unmerged at this date), so the server answered the no-key request 200 even though APR_API_KEY_HASH was set and the entrypoint accepted it. No Function URL was created. Plan 09-08 (the HTTPS steps) waits on a release carrying the D-04 auth fix, and ONLY that fix (D-05: the content and alias fixes never gate the turn or the ingress). If no such release ever ships, plans 09-08 and 09-10 close the phase as incomplete-awaiting-auth-release, with SC1 and SC3 reported not delivered and no ingress created.
auth.risk_acceptance: Cost amplification: a public AuthType NONE URL on this server would let any caller buy a cold start (about $0.005 at 10,240 MB, measured here at $0.0039 for the 29.1 s billed cold start of the proof) and, because the pin does not gate the key, free inference. Hence no URL exists. The function is reachable only through IAM-authenticated lambda:Invoke; reserved concurrency is 1 (the operator's choice via the option id), which also enforces one conversation per process.
